issues.description: NamespaceSealed stub returns false unconditionally while live callers depend on it
issues.detail: Core.NamespaceSealed always returns false with a TODO, yet ListAllNamespaces and other callers are already wired against it. The seal-aware path is dead until SealManager lands, and a permanently-false security predicate masquerading as a real check invites silent misuse. Gate callers behind a build tag, return ErrNotImplemented, or land both halves together.

issues.description: ACL.root overloads a *Namespace pointer to encode both is-root and owning-namespace
issues.detail: The root field is now a *namespace.Namespace where nil means not-root and non-nil means root-scoped-to-this-namespace. That sentinel-pointer trick complects two concerns (authorization decision and namespace identity) into one nillable value. A small struct or RootScope type would make AllowOperation self-evident instead of relying on an unstated convention.

issues.description: Sealed-namespace error detection uses substring matching instead of errors.Is on the sentinel
issues.detail: AdjustErrorStatusCode dispatches via errwrap.Contains(err, consts.ErrNamespaceSealed.Error()), a substring search of error text. Errors are values, not strings: errors.Is on the sentinel is robust and survives wrapping. The current form will false-positive on any error whose text happens to contain the substring and false-negative on translated variants.

issues.description: ACL root contract silently broadened from boolean to ancestor-namespace check without spec update
issues.detail: The root field changed from bool to *namespace.Namespace, and AllowOperation now grants root privileges when ns.HasParent(a.root) holds. The previous contract was root-only-in-root-namespace; the new one grants root in N and all descendants. This authorization-boundary change ships with no doc comment, no migration note, and thin test coverage (only ns1 vs root).

issues.description: ListAllNamespaces swapped to ListNamespaces at multiple call sites without contract clarity
issues.detail: Calls in loadLoginMFAConfigs, runLockedUserEntryUpdates, entityGaugeCollector, and countActiveTokens were moved from ListAllNamespaces(ctx, true) to ListNamespaces(ctx). The PR says ListAllNamespaces now includes sealed namespaces, yet these callers were moved off it. Risk: MFA enforcement, locked-user updates, and token counts now silently skip sealed namespaces. Document each method's postcondition.

issues.description: NSTokenLength built via byte indexing of a string literal is cute rather than clear
issues.detail: NSTokenLength = TokenLen + "."[1] + nsID extracts a separator byte by indexing a literal. Name the separator (const NSTokenSeparator = '.') and derive lengths from that. The current arithmetic leaks the namespaced-token format through literal indexing and confuses future readers; any delimiter change touches many files.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the PR moves in a simpler direction overall — collapsing namespaceMountEntryView into NamespaceView().SubView() and tightening the response_util switch are real wins. The central concern is the silent broadening of the ACL root contract: root field changed from bool to *Namespace and AllowOperation now grants root via HasParent across descendants, with no spec, doc comment, or adequate tests. NamespaceSealed shipping as a permanently-false stub with live callers is a footgun, and substring matching on error text for sealed detection should use errors.Is on the sentinel. Multiple ListAllNamespaces-to-ListNamespaces swaps need their postconditions clarified before merge. Land the ACL.root spec, gate or implement NamespaceSealed, and treat errors as values.
